summary: The main article describes the transition of a dual photoredox and nickel-catalyzed C(sp2)-C(sp3) cross-coupling from batch to flow, featuring optimization tables and a scope scheme. The experimental section provides detailed characterization for 17 specific products synthesized using the flow protocol.
